shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!dist'"' | sed -n '1,200p' && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---' && git status --short && for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' app/globals.css lib/products.ts next.config.ts; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const r=require('react'); console.log(require('react/package.json').version, typeof r.ViewTransition, typeof r.addTransitionType)\" && rg -n \"viewTransition|ViewTransition|navigation-forward|navigation-back\" node_modules/next node_modules/react node_modules/@types/react -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' -g '*.mjs' | sed -n '1,220p'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- next config type ---\\n' && rg -n \"viewTransition\\??:\" node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' | head -20 && printf '\\n--- package lock versions ---\\n' && npm ls next react react-dom --depth=0"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"experimental:\\s*\\{["'^}]*viewTransition|viewTransition: true|<ViewTransition" node_modules/next -g '"'*.tsx' -g '*.ts' -g '*.js' --glob '"'!**/compiled/**'"' | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '\\n--- react aliases ---\\n'; rg -n \"react-experimental|react-dom-experimental|viewTransition\" node_modules/next/dist/build node_modules/next/dist/server -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,160p'"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: app/layout.tsx
@@
           update={{
             'navigation-forward': 'page-forward',
             'navigation-back': 'page-back',
+            default: 'none',
           }}
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n--- diff stat ---\\n' && git diff --stat && printf '\\n--- diff ---\\n' && git diff -- app next.config.ts react-canary.d.ts tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- untracked declarations ---\\n' && ls -la next-env.d.ts react-canary.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true && cat next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore && git diff -- package.json && git show HEAD:package.json'

/bin/bash -lc 'rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
git checkout -- tsconfig.json
npx tsc --noEmit'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n--- changed files ---\\n' && git diff --name-only && printf '\\n--- key lines ---\\n' && nl -ba app/layout.tsx | sed -n '1,80p' && nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx | sed -n '1,80p' && nl -ba 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' | sed -n '30,90p' && nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '120,240p' && nl -ba next.config.ts && nl -ba react-canary.d.ts"
